Method of Attack: Lack of authentication in cups-browsed allowing unauthenticated access via UDP port 631
Unfiltered parameter injection in IPP attributes leading to unsafe PPD file creation
Arbitrary command execution via FoomaticRIPCommandLine directive in PPD files
Impacted Systems: Any UNIX-based system with CUPS service
Attack Vector: Exploitation of UDP port 631 to trigger IPP requests
Injection of malicious IPP attributes into PPD files
Execution of arbitrary commands via FoomaticRIPCommandLine directive
